title: Senior AI Engineer — Founding Team
summary: Own the intelligence layer of Redrob's product — ranking, retrieval, and matching systems that decide what recruiters and candidates see.
mandate: Audit current BM25 + rule-based scoring and identify highest-leverage fixes
Ship a v2 ranking system with embeddings and hybrid retrieval
Set up evaluation infrastructure — offline benchmarks, A/B testing, recruiter feedback loops
must_have: Production embeddings-based retrieval (sentence-transformers, BGE, E5, OpenAI embeddings)
Vector DB / hybrid search (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch)
Strong Python with production code quality
Ranking evaluation frameworks (NDCG, MRR, MAP, offline-to-online correlation, A/B testing)
nice_to_have: HR-tech / recruiting tech / marketplace product experience
Distributed systems or large-scale inference optimization
disqualifiers: Pure research environments without production deployment
AI experience only via LangChain + OpenAI under 12 months without prior ML production
Senior engineer who hasn't written production code in 18+ months
Entire career at consulting firms (TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, Cognizant, Capgemini)
Computer vision / speech / robotics without significant NLP/IR exposure
hackathon_notes: Keyword stuffing in skills is a trap — title and career history matter more
Tier-5 candidates may not say RAG/Pinecone but built recommendation systems at product companies
Behavioral signals matter: inactive candidates with low response rates should be down-weighted
Honeypot profiles with impossible timelines must be filtered (>10% in top-100 disqualifies)
